description: Authoritative phone-to-vehicle mounting alignment status enums as defined by Architecture Revision 3 Component C-05.

definitions.UNALIGNED: Initial unknown mounting orientation relative to vehicle chassis.
definitions.COARSE_ALIGNING: Initial gravity vector and coarse forward heading estimation in progress.
definitions.FINE_ALIGNING: Dynamic acceleration and turn angular velocity coupling refinement.
definitions.ALIGNED: Stable alignment achieved; phone-to-vehicle rotation matrix valid.
definitions.MOUNT_SLIP_DETECTED: Sudden rotation rate or acceleration discontinuity detected relative to vehicle motion.
definitions.REALIGNING: Alignment reset and re-estimation initiated following slip event.
